parsed.main_gap: none of substance; the tree-component step is justified by a false claim (that a graph with fewer edges than vertices is acyclic), though existence of one tree component follows trivially and suffices.

errors.description: Lower bound of the refinement lemma: the write-up asserts that floor(r/2) <= q-1 edges on q vertices forces the multigraph to have no cycle and no loop, so every component is a tree. This is false (e.g. a triangle plus isolated vertices). Only the existence of some tree component is needed, which does follow from e < v by summing v_C - e_C over components; but the stated justification and the phrase 'the component containing a_q' are incorrect as written.
errors.quote: Having fewer edges than vertices, the graph contains no cycle and no loop, since a cycle or a loop on \(v\) vertices already uses at least \(v\) edges; hence every connected component \(C\) has \(e_C=v_C-1\) and is a tree

parsed.notes: Correct answer 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1). Drafting lemma (value = alternating sum) is proved correctly by induction. Refinement lemma both directions are sound: pairing/tree-bipartition gives D >= Γ; overlay construction with <= q-1 cuts gives D <= Γ. Pigeonhole upper bound and dyadic construction are correct. Sections 5-6 are irrelevant filler.
